high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram story by Kylie Jenner, as indicated by the username "kyliejenner" at the top left corner of the image. The post was made 31 minutes prior to the screenshot being taken. There are multiple individuals partially visible in the background. One person is wearing bright green pants and a blue top, while another is dressed in black. The focus is on the hands holding cans of a drink brand called "Sprinter." Three cans of "Sprinter" are prominently displayed in the foreground. Each can has a different flavor
